slides.0.title: Industry and Market
slides.0.subtitle: Concentration, export reliance, and the 2024–2025 pressures and tariffs
slides.1.title: Industry structure
slides.1.highlights.0.title: Cognac: highly concentrated
slides.1.highlights.0.content: The Big Four supplied over 90% of Cognac sold in the US (2008 estimate, Wikipedia) and depend on many small growers for eau-de-vie
slides.1.highlights.1.title: Armagnac: small producers
slides.1.highlights.1.content: About 3 million bottles against about 220 million for Cognac (Wikipedia figures), mostly small producers
slides.1.highlights.2.title: Other regions
slides.1.highlights.2.content: South Africa is organised around names such as KWV (formed in 1918); German Weinbrand may use imported base wine, showing how supply chains differ
slides.1.content: Comparing industry structure is a common Diploma essay angle.
slides.2.title: Pressures in 2024–2025
slides.2.highlights.0.title: Export decline
slides.2.highlights.0.content: BNIC: global export value fell 10.6% in 2024; Far East (mainly China) fell 24.2% in value; China fell 23.8% in value and 9.6% in volume (The Drinks Business)
slides.2.highlights.1.title: China's anti-dumping duties
slides.2.highlights.1.content: On 4 July 2025 China's commerce ministry issued the final ruling, applying 27.7–34.9% duties on EU brandy from 5 July; the BNIC says it also covers Armagnac and marc spirits; some companies are exempt through minimum-price undertakings (Just Drinks)
slides.2.highlights.2.title: Possible responses
slides.2.highlights.2.content: Cut yields, diversify markets, stress premium and old stocks, and build cocktail occasions (an analytical suggestion, not a sourced fact)
slides.2.content: Market figures date quickly, so state the year when you write.
slides.3.title: A cause-and-effect chain
slides.3.highlights.0.title: Demand falls
slides.3.highlights.0.content: Exports fall → stocks build → yields and purchase prices are cut → grower incomes are squeezed
slides.3.highlights.1.title: Two sides of concentration
slides.3.highlights.1.content: Big houses have marketing and stock strength, but heavy reliance on one market such as China magnifies policy risk
slides.3.highlights.2.title: Advantages of small regions
slides.3.highlights.2.content: Armagnac's vintage tradition and grower stories suit niche markets, though small scale limits resilience
slides.3.content: Essays should link fact, mechanism and conclusion.
